title: BDEX V3 (BOT Chain) + RocketSwap-Anubis (Anubis) — gated bridge/DEX cluster
closed_reasons: BDEX V3 core byte-identical to canonical Uniswap V3 v1.0.0 (only pragma/comment diffs in libraries)
BDEX V3 pool tokens: USDT mint is MINTER_ROLE-gated (EOA holder), WBOT is canonical WETH, all other pool counterparties fixed-supply or role-gated
RocketSwap Anubis pair/factory are a faithful 0.8.20 port of canonical UniV2 (only revert-string diffs)
Anubis synthetic DAI/USDT mint gated to two HyperlaneTokenBridge contracts

Bridge inbound path requires a canonical Hyperlane StaticMerkleRootMultisigIsm (2-of-3) behind a canonical Hyperlane Mailbox; ISM implementation byte-matches @hyperlane-xyz/core v10.1.5 (only PACKAGE_VERSION differs)
Forged Hyperlane messages rejected on fork (empty metadata and fake signature variants)
ProtocolReserve (56.78M DAI) withdraw reverts 'ProtocolReserve: not admin'
No skim-able excess in the top pools (reserves == balances); LP round-trip and swaps are canonical (no free money)
All top pool counterparty tokens: mint reverts (role/vault/no-mint); no oracle exposure
key_facts: RocketSwap Anubis TVL $354.2M = synthetic DAI 257.76M + USDT 162.48M minted by a custom HyperlaneTokenBridge
Collateral backing on Ethereum/BSC/Polygon ≈ $424M (2.67M+114.60M+45.38M USDT, 51.28M+0.14M+51.80M DAI, 155.0M DAI private, plus USDC/ETH/BNB/POL)
Bridge ISMs: canonical Hyperlane 2-of-3 multisig, six validator EOAs, identical on all four chains
Owner EOA 0x73d7297753F47414A436c1b4123C5113917a496d controls UUPS upgrades, mailboxes, tokens on all chains (P)
BDEX V3 main pool 0x64F418471a1A7932a190E10da5A8551dB5AbeC05 = 15,625,899.53 USDT + 1,255,110.55 WBOT; implied WBOT ≈ $12.45; BDEX V2 WBOT/USDT ≈ $12.28 (no arb)
BOT-chain USDT is a team-issued OZ ERC20 (MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on EOA 0x7800c931df97320d05977998512d6214a8df42b1), not canonical Tether
No permissionless function in either cluster pays the caller: swap/mint/burn/skim are canonical; claimPending only settles the caller's own claims; handle is mailbox-gated
caveats: The $354M/$424M is fully reachable by the owner EOA or any 2-of-3 validator keys (privileged, not unprivileged)
BOT-chain 'USDT' is team-issued; its $1 valuation (and thus the $31M BDEX TVL) depends on the issuer honouring it
Public bridge daily mint limit is 1M USDT / 1M DAI per 24h (rate-limited run risk, not an exploit)
Periphery contracts (routers / NFT position managers) were not exhaustively enumerated; they cannot drain pool reserves
USD figures are face-value stablecoin amounts at the recorded blocks; public RPCs are rate-limited
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from BDEX V3 (BOT) and RocketSwap-Anubis: the DEX cores are canonical Uniswap V3/V2, the Anubis $354M is synthetic minted only via a canonical Hyperlane 2-of-3 multisig bridge (ISM byte-verified against @hyperlane-xyz/core v10.1.5), and every pool counterparty token mint is role/vault-gated; the real exposure is privileged (owner EOA + validator keys).
